destinations.title: Dharamshala
destinations.description: The Kangra Valley gateway town below the Dhauladhar range — the arrival point for this corner of Himachal, with McLeod Ganj as a separate destination further up the hill.

destinations.title: Tirthan Valley
destinations.description: Crystal-clear rivers, lush forests and peaceful stays.

destinations.title: Jibhi
destinations.description: A sleepy riverside hamlet of wooden cottages and waterfall trails in the Banjar Valley.

destinations.title: Chitkul
destinations.description: The last inhabited village on the old Hindustan-Tibet trade route, deep in the Baspa Valley.

destinations.title: Sainj Valley
destinations.description: A quiet valley on the Great Himalayan National Park buffer, built around meadow villages like Shangarh.

destinations.title: Bir Billing
destinations.description: India's best-known paragliding site, paired with a slow-paced Tibetan settlement village.

destinations.title: Sangla Valley
destinations.description: Apple orchards and apricot groves along the Baspa river, deep in the Kinnaur Himalayas.

destinations.title: Chamba
destinations.description: A former Himalayan princely capital on the Ravi River, built around temples and a historic town square.

destinations.title: Dalhousie
destinations.description: A colonial-era hill station spread across five hills, built by the British as a summer retreat in 1850.

destinations.title: Khajjiar
destinations.description: A small meadow and lake ringed by deodar forest, roughly midway between Dalhousie and Chamba.

destinations.title: Munsiyari
destinations.description: A quiet hill town beneath the Panchachuli peaks, gateway to Uttarakhand’s remote Johar Valley.

destinations.title: Srinagar
destinations.description: Kashmir’s valley capital — Dal Lake, Mughal gardens and centuries of houseboat life.

destinations.title: Pahalgam
destinations.description: A Lidder Valley mountain base, and the Kashmir Valley’s classic multi-day retreat.

destinations.title: Sonamarg
destinations.description: A high-altitude valley on the Srinagar–Leh road, and gateway to Kashmir’s glacier and lake treks.

destinations.title: Dehradun
destinations.description: The Doon Valley capital and Garhwal's main gateway, with a quieter identity of its own.

destinations.title: Mussoorie
destinations.description: A ridge-top hill station above the Doon Valley, built around Mall Road and its viewpoints.

destinations.title: Joshimath (Jyotirmath)
destinations.description: Upper Garhwal's practical mountain base, and the gateway town beneath Auli.

destinations.title: Auli
destinations.description: A high-altitude slope above Joshimath, India's best-known ski destination in winter.

destinations.title: Chopta
destinations.description: A small meadow base in Rudraprayag district, and the trailhead for Tungnath and Chandrashila.

destinations.title: Lansdowne
destinations.description: A quiet cantonment hill town in Pauri Garhwal, built for a short, unhurried break.

destinations.title: Nainital
destinations.description: Kumaon's best-known lake town, built in tiers around the crescent-shaped Naini Lake.

destinations.title: Mukteshwar
destinations.description: A quiet ridge village above the Kumaon orchards, built around a cliff viewpoint and an old temple.

destinations.title: Almora
destinations.description: A former Chand-dynasty hill capital, and Kumaon's cultural and market town.

destinations.title: Kausani
destinations.description: A small ridge settlement in Bageshwar district, built almost entirely around its Himalayan panorama.

destinations.title: Ranikhet
destinations.description: A quiet cantonment town in Almora district, home to the Kumaon Regiment and its orchard gardens.

destinations.title: Badrinath
destinations.description: A seasonal Char Dham temple town on the Alaknanda, reached by road beyond Joshimath.

destinations.title: Gangotri
destinations.description: A road-accessible Char Dham temple town on the Bhagirathi, and the gateway to the separate Gaumukh trek.

destinations.title: Kedarnath
destinations.description: A trek-gated Char Dham shrine at 3,583 m — the road ends at Gaurikund, and the final distance is on foot or by seasonal helicopter.

destinations.title: Yamunotri
destinations.description: A trek-gated Char Dham shrine above Janki Chatti, the source of the Yamuna in a narrow Himalayan gorge.

destinations.title: Hemkund Sahib
destinations.description: The world's highest Gurudwara, on a glacial lake at 4,329 m, reached by trek from the shared Ghangaria base.

destinations.title: Kasauli
destinations.description: A small colonial cantonment town in pine and oak forest, built around 19th-century churches and viewpoints.

destinations.title: McLeod Ganj
destinations.description: The hillside Tibetan-culture hub above Dharamshala — home to the Dalai Lama’s temple complex and the Tibetan government-in-exile since 1960.

destinations.title: Katra
destinations.description: The base town for the Vaishno Devi pilgrimage — where travelers register, stay, and begin the route to the Bhawan.

places.title: Yatra Registration Counter, Katra bus stand

destinations.title: Chail
destinations.description: A former royal summer retreat in the Shivalik foothills, with a hillside cricket ground long noted as one of the highest anywhere.

destinations.title: Bhaderwah
destinations.description: A bowl-shaped valley town known regionally as "Mini Kashmir" for meadows, orchards and springs, with lighter tourism infrastructure than the Kashmir Valley.

destinations.title: Jammu
destinations.description: The "City of Temples" on the Tawi River — Jammu & Kashmir’s winter capital, and a common gateway before Kashmir or the hills beyond.

destinations.title: Patnitop
destinations.description: A forested hill station on the Jammu–Srinagar highway, known for winter skiing at nearby Madha Top and summer meadow walks.

destinations.title: Ramnagar
destinations.description: The gateway town to Corbett Tiger Reserve, India’s oldest national park.

destinations.title: Kangra
destinations.description: A historic fort-and-temple town, home to the largest fort in the Indian Himalayas and the Brajeshwari Devi Temple.

destinations.title: Sarahan
destinations.description: A temple town on the old Hindustan-Tibet road, built around the Bhimakali Temple and known as the gateway to Kinnaur.

destinations.title: Palampur
destinations.description: Himachal’s tea-growing town, built around plantations and the Neugal Khad gorge.

destinations.title: Pragpur
destinations.description: India’s first officially declared Heritage Village, built by the Kuthiala Sud clan in the 17th century.

destinations.title: Kufri
destinations.description: A Shimla-area hill stop built around a high-altitude nature park and family activity ground.

destinations.title: Naggar
destinations.description: The former capital of the Kullu kingdom, home to a 15th-century castle and the Nicholas Roerich estate.

destinations.title: Jawalamukhi
destinations.description: A Shakti Peeth pilgrimage town built around the Jwalamukhi Temple and its natural flame.

destinations.title: Narkanda
destinations.description: An apple-country hill town on the old Hindustan-Tibet road, and the base for Hatu Peak.

destinations.title: Kullu
destinations.description: The valley’s administrative and religious center, home to the Raghunath Temple and the internationally recognized Kullu Dussehra festival.

destinations.title: Keylong
destinations.description: The district headquarters of Lahaul and Spiti, and a base for exploring the Lahaul valley.

destinations.title: Kibber
destinations.description: One of the highest permanently inhabited villages in India, and the base for the Kibber Wildlife Sanctuary.

destinations.title: Bharmour
destinations.description: A Budhil-valley temple town and the traditional base for the Manimahesh Kailash pilgrimage.

destinations.title: Tabo
destinations.description: A thousand-year-old monastery town in Spiti, known for murals often compared to the Ajanta Caves.

destinations.title: Rewalsar
destinations.description: A small lake revered by Hindus, Buddhists and Sikhs alike, known to Tibetan Buddhists as Tso Pema.

destinations.title: Renuka Ji
destinations.description: Himachal’s largest natural lake, revered as the embodiment of the goddess Renuka, ringed by a wildlife sanctuary.

destinations.title: Dhankar
destinations.description: A cliffside monastery and village above the Spiti–Pin confluence, and the starting point for the Dhankar Lake trek.

destinations.title: Mandi
destinations.description: Known as "Chhoti Kashi" for its many temples, set at the confluence of the Suketi and Beas rivers.

destinations.title: Paonta Sahib
destinations.description: A Yamuna-riverside town founded by Guru Gobind Singh, and a significant Sikh pilgrimage site.

destinations.title: Naldehra
destinations.description: A forested meadow around one of North India's earliest hill-station golf courses, about 22 km from Shimla.

destinations.title: Manikaran
destinations.description: A Sikh–Hindu pilgrimage town in the Parvati Valley, built around hot springs and the Gurdwara Sri Manikaran Sahib.

destinations.title: Pangi Valley
destinations.description: A remote, tribal Chenab-gorge valley in Chamba district, cut off from the world for much of the year.

destinations.title: Chintpurni
destinations.description: A Shakti Peeth pilgrimage town in Una district, built around the Mata Chintpurni Temple.

destinations.title: Naina Devi
destinations.description: A hilltop Shakti Peeth temple in Bilaspur district overlooking Gobind Sagar Lake — distinct from the Naina Devi Temple at Nainital, Uttarakhand.

destinations.title: Mashobra
destinations.description: A cedar-forested hill town beyond Shimla's bustle, home to the Rashtrapati Niwas presidential retreat.

destinations.title: Manali
destinations.description: Snow peaks, river valleys, and adventure sports.

destinations.title: Spiti Valley
destinations.description: Remote high-altitude desert with ancient monasteries and dramatic lunar landscapes.

destinations.title: Kinnaur
destinations.description: Ancient villages, apple orchards and dramatic valleys along the historic Hindustan–Tibet Road.

destinations.title: Shimla
destinations.description: Pine-clad ridgelines and heritage architecture along the historic Mall Road.

destinations.title: Gulmarg
destinations.description: Alpine meadows and snow-capped peaks in Kashmir, home to one of the world’s highest gondola rides.

destinations.title: Rishikesh
destinations.description: Uttarakhand’s yoga capital, with Ganga aartis, ashrams, and Himalayan white-water rafting.

destinations.title: Kasol
destinations.description: Riverside cafés, treks and laid-back mountain life.

destinations.title: Haridwar
destinations.description: One of Hinduism’s seven holiest cities in Uttarakhand, anchored by the sacred Har Ki Pauri ghat.
